title: Odyssey Cultural Fest 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 301 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 61,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
